name: "Animal Face" Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter or Chocolate Hazelnut Spread & Mixed Fruits (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ (454 g) pkg strawberries
½ (170 g) pkg blueberries
1 banana

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice strawberries lengthwise. Place on a plate along with the blueberries.
Peel banana and cut half crosswise into thin rounds. Halve remaining banana lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add banana to the plate with the berries.
Place peanut butter and chocolate hazelnut spread each in their own small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup natural peanut butter
½ cup chocolate hazelnut spread

instructions.primary_message: Place rice cakes on a flat surface. Get the kids to help spread rice cakes with either peanut butter or chocolate hazelnut spread, then decorate with fruit to make animal faces, fun designs, or anything else that your imagination can come up with!
Divide decorated rice cakes between plates and enjoy!
